# Fixture Co

> Fixture Co publishes small, stable, deterministic websites so crawler and
> site-health pipelines can be tested end to end. Every page is static,
> server-rendered HTML with frozen content.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/): fixture root and navigation hub
- [Blog: How deterministic crawlers classify pages](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/blog/post-1/): article fixture
- [Pricing](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/pricing/): pricing fixture
- [Docs: Getting started](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/docs/intro/): documentation fixture
- [FAQ](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/faq/): frequently asked questions fixture
- [Product: Fixture Widget](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/product/widget/): product fixture
- [Category: Shoes](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/category/shoes/): category fixture
- [About](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/about/): about/contact fixture
- [Misc notes](https://swk5bwh3qdbz.preview.us1.vorflux.com/misc/plain/): signal-free control page
